dedupe_keys.name: real scale experimental assessment of pile group dynamic impedance eries respond

description: RESPOND combines forced-vibration tests on a two-by-two pile-group foundation, tests with the EuroProteas prototype on that foundation, and static loading of a single pile. Acceleration and displacement measurements span soil, piles, foundation and roof. Dynamic excitation ranges from 1 to 10 hertz and 0.1 to 20 kilonewtons. The dataset is provided by EUROSEISTEST and EUROPROTEAS through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2024. The provider metadata identifies files whose format is not established. The public landing page does not establish working data-file access or charges. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
